items.title: Should You Buy NetApp Stock For The Shares It Keeps Retiring?
items.summary: NetApp (NTAP) has spent years quietly retiring its own stock while the attention went to its flash arrays and AI deals. The stock is not quiet now: it has gained about 92% over the trailing six months and sits roughly 5% below its 52-week high. Fewer shares mean each one carries more of the profit. The question is what that is worth at this price.

items.title: Did SMCI Stock Just Rise For The Wrong Reason?
items.summary: Super Micro Computer (SMCI) stock rose 9.5% on Thursday, September 17, closing just over $40. The move followed a bullish call on how big the market for AI servers gets. That call may well be right. But it answers a question Super Micro's own results never raised. That is why one big session tells you less than it looks like it does.

items.title: Say What? This AI Stock Gets Support, Eyes New Entry As Earnings Surge 66%
items.summary: Artificial intelligence has come under renewed scrutiny. But this AI stock is eyeing an entry amid bullish support as profits pop.

items.title: Can Hewlett Packard Enterprise Stock Keep Running On Orders It Cannot Ship?
items.summary: Hewlett Packard Enterprise (HPE) has returned 156% over the trailing twelve months, and the stock now sits right at the top of its 52-week range. The next leg is the hard one. What could power it is already on the company's books: orders it has taken and cannot yet ship.

items.title: Did NetApp Borrow Its Record Quarter From The Rest Of The Year?
items.summary: NetApp (NTAP) has returned about 57% over the past twelve months, and it has just raised its revenue outlook for fiscal 2027 by $650 million. The easy read is that an AI storage boom is only getting started. The analysts who cover NetApp full-time kept returning to a narrower point: how much of a record quarter came from customers buying early, and what that leaves for the rest of the year.
